The '''''Kossak''-class Frigate''' was a frigate manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]].<ref name="LONH" />

==Characteristics==
''Kossak''-class frigates were armed with a dozen [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries, a dozen twin light [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], four twin medium [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], and a pair of heavy [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam]] emitters. It was well equipped with both armor and [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]]. It also carried a small [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay which supported a dozen [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and three [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]].<ref name="LONH" />

==History==
It was designed specifically for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], and was widely used to defend Hutt interests against pirates or rivals.<ref name="LONH" />
